descriptions.zh: 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知。
descriptions.en: This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the API immediately returns a job ID. The job is then queued for asynchronous processing. A callback delivers the final result.
